input.quote: 26. APPLICABLE LAW. This Agreement shall be governed, construed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the State of California (without respect to principles of conflicts of law).
input.rationale: Sections 26 and 27 select California law with exclusive venue in the state or federal courts of San Luis Obispo County, California, and each party consents to that jurisdiction. California law and California courts are within the playbook's accepted list (fallback position), and there is no arbitration provision anywhere in the agreement (searches for "arbitration" return no results), so no foreign arbitral seat or foreign exclusive venue is imposed. The clause is mutual and does not reach the walk-away position, so we accept it as drafted rather than spending negotiating capital to move to the preferred New York forum.
